name: Voymastina: AK-15 on foot (test)
description: Test build of Voymastina's GFL1 kit as AK-15, to be merged into Voymastina for when she fights on foot after her mech falls. Run it together with Voymastina (her fists). Rage: her hits may make her rage, hitting harder. Eye of the White Mastiff (N): monitors nearby enemies, her hits on them hit harder and theirs on her softer, until it overloads. Blood-Curdling Howl: when she monitors more than 5 enemies, or on Ctrl+N (stands in for being thrown out of her mech): immune for a moment, and a blast on the strongest enemy near. Settings in voymastina-ak15.ini (edit with the game closed).
